rulings.Case Title: IN THE MATTER OF THE CAROLYN DALEY LIVING TRUST
rulings.Calendar Matter: Petitioner Prays For An Order From The San Francisco Superior Court To The San Farncisco Recorder To Record Carolyn Daley'S Trust
rulings.Rulings: Continued to 09/22/2026. Procedural issues posted in the court's 05/12/2026 tentative ruling remain unaddressed: 1) A petition involving a trust must state the names and last known addresses of all vested or contingent beneficiaries (CRC 7.902). 2) No Notice of Hearing (Form DE-120) with complete proof of service is on file with the court (Probate Code Section 17203). 3) The petition requests the notary, Wyman Howard, be directed to pay costs incurred, but no notice was given to Wyman Howard. The court will consider taking the petition off calendar if no progress on the issues stated above is made before the next hearing.
